# Initialize-AvmBicepWorkflowMatrix

## Synopsis

Discover a checked-out Bicep workflow matrix for a push, pull request, or manual run.

## Description

Validates the exact checked-out target commit before building a module
matrix. Pull request discovery requires the tested merge commit to have
exactly two parents and verifies the supplied pull request head is the
second parent. Push discovery uses the supplied base when available and
otherwise selects every current module for static-only preview. Manual
dispatch uses explicit module paths.

## Syntax

```powershell
Initialize-AvmBicepWorkflowMatrix [-Root] <string> [-EventName] <string> [-TargetCommit] <string> [[-BaseCommit] <string>] [[-PullRequestHeadCommit] <string>] [[-ModulePaths] <string>] [[-CreateReleaseTag] <bool>] [[-PublishOnly] <bool>] [[-StaticValidation] <bool>] [[-DeploymentValidation] <bool>] [[-RemoveDeployment] <bool>] [[-CustomLocation] <string>] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## Examples

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
Initialize-AvmBicepWorkflowMatrix -Root $repo -EventName workflow_dispatch -TargetCommit $sha -ModulePaths 'avm/res/storage/storage-account'
```
